description: This file defines the CrossfadeActivity class, an Android activity demonstrating cross-fading between two overlapping views: a loading indicator and content view, with toggle functionality in the options menu.

classes.name: CrossfadeActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages cross-fading between a content view and a loading spinner, responding to menu actions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates layout, finds views, and caches animation duration.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for the activity.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling the content/loading views or navigating up.

methods.name: showContentOrLoadingIndicator
methods.description: Performs cross-fade animation between content and loading views based on the boolean parameter.
